name: area-chart
title: Area chart
description: A line chart filled down to zero, optionally stacked to show a running total.
a11y: The chart is role=img with the required title as its name.
A visually hidden table lists every value, one row per category, for screen readers.
One focusable stop per category with a spoken label; Arrow keys move between them and Escape hides the tooltip.
The value tooltip opens on hover and on keyboard focus; stacked charts also show the total.
Series differ by fill pattern and dash as well as colour, and the legend names them.
